verification_report.summary: All positive uniqueness criteria and their proofs in Sections 1–6 pass the strict sequential audit. Signs, normalizations, low-regularity arguments, hypersurface topology, exterior-ball and orbit propagation, and bounded Guan–Li primary-source interfaces were checked; no critical errors or substantive gaps were found. Theorem 1.4's sharpness claim and Sections 7 onward are excluded. Full readable report: results/uniqueness_criteria_01/verification_report.md.
